title: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 描述评分指标或评测协议

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce \textbf{\ourmethod}, a benchmark for focus-task resumption in sessions that interleave unfinished tasks drawn from the same source repository, with a persistent checkout for each task.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 7 coding agents, interleaved unfinished work produces an average focus-task resolution gap of 11.5 percentage points, ranging from 6.0 to 15.0 percentage points.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The switched session interleaves ordered stages from other unfinished tasks in the same repository, while only the final focus patch is scored. \ourmethod~contains 200 focus tasks from 19 Python repositories, reconstructed from issue, pull-request, and review histories and rendered as 400 matched session specifications.
